name: Tsumaranai Mainichi o Chi de Somete
original_name: つまらない毎日を血で染めて
source:
It was a rainy day like any other.
But then Sakito came across something that doesn't happen on any ordinary day.

"Don't let your guard down, just because you're a man.
These are dangerous times... You might run into a murderer.
Like me..."
